إجراء:
Major Maintenance 
 Procedures (P1 Y4) 
 OR 36000 HRS

This document outlines the
إجراءات الصيانة الرئيسية 
P1, which must be carried out
every four years as 
indicated by Y4 in the above title block. This pump is used to pumped 
feed water from feed water tank to high pressure heater.

The first draft initiated 
and tested by eng. 
Adel Saad Zaghloul, reviewed by eng. 
Sobhy Abel Halim, 
accepted by eng. 
محمد عبد ال 
غفار 
general director of 
Alarish PS, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Abouda Elbana.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Disconnect the suction & discharge flanges and 
 all oil and water piping including the balancing line

Be sure pump 
 must be completely drainage.

Remove the pump protection guard and 
 insulating cover.

 half upper case (352.02).

Lift the shaft slightly, rotate the half lower bearing (313.02) and the 
 labyrinth seal ring (423.02) inside housing to remove them.

House the O- ring gasket (412.01), assemble the suction casing and 
 cooling jacket cover (165.02).
Spread o thin layer of anti seizing paste on the shaft.

Sling the shaft, lift it in the suction casing and place wooden blocks to 
 avoid bending and deformation.

Mount the bearing housing lower half without bearing nor labyrinth , screw the

 (920.02).

 shaft.

sections.text: Use four tie bolts with centering bush (546.01) and nut (920.03).

Fit the tie bolts in the suction casing until the longest threaded part goes 
 out from the delivery side.
Mount the centering pin bush and nuts (920.03)
Tighten the tie rod one nut, then on the opposite one.

Unloose the four tie bolts, reset the pump perfectly on the base plate, lock 
 the suction casing on the base plate.
Place the delivery casing on the base plate without locking.
